caption: The drawing depicts a single sculptural object, which is a detailed, carved figurehead of a woman. The figure is rendered in shades of light beige and cream, resembling marble or painted wood, set against a solid, flat blue-gray background. The woman is dressed in elaborate, layered period clothing with decorative scalloped edges, ruffled sleeves, and a prominent, pleated skirt. Her hair is arranged up, and she appears to be looking slightly upward with her chin raised. The arms are bent, and one hand is visible near her hip, while the other is partially obscured. Ornamental elements, such as a bow on her chest and intricate scrollwork at the base, enhance her attire and the overall design. The figurehead has a solid backing, possibly indicating it is meant to be attached to another surface, and the scrollwork at the bottom suggests it is part of a nautical or architectural piece. The shading and contours are carefully rendered, providing a sense of dimensionality to the object.
title: Figurehead
